name: broadbanner-social-distribution
description: Social posting toolkit for BroadBanner creators (Core tier / banner_blast). Post text, image, and video notes to Substack/Bluesky/Threads and release queued Substack notes and clips. Banner and Backbone Media posts from the Claude built-in browser, other accounts from Chrome, with a signed-in check before every post. Live-stream scheduling moved to the broadbanner-live-production plugin.
